recording.how: go-trader record-observations --kinds trade_flow on BTC, ETH and HYPE from before the train window start through the test window end; copy the closed run (run.manifest.json and every segment) here and pin the run manifest sha256

side_evidence.how: taker-fill side verification over the recording, as in the cumulative_volume_delta_divergence_1638 side_evidence.py procedure, for every coin

sealed_payloads.how: sealed market payloads captured from an explicit-paper shared-feed run of the candidate over part of the recording, for the sealed-versus-replayed decision proof

offline_manifest_shape: offline_candle_manifest/v7 with the spec windows, warmup_bars at least the support horizon, and per coin: candles, funding, trade_flow (series replayed from the recording by backtest/trade_flow_replay.py) and htf_candles (pinned one-hour candles)
